title: Autotune quality guard with reference corpus and rollback playbook
creator: Maya Patel
description: Objective: Build an automated quality-guarding pipeline that validates batching and KV-prefix caching recommendations before applying them to serving clusters, and provides a deterministic rollback playbook when regressions are detected. The system will use a curated reference prompt corpus, fast micro-evals, and both absolute and relative acceptance thresholds. The goal is to reduce per-token costs safely while keeping generation quality at or above SLA bounds.
acceptance_criteria: Automated eval job that runs recommended config (batch size, cache TTL, cache policy) against reference corpus within a staging cluster
Quantitative regression detection implemented: accepts both task-level metric drops and aggregate quality delta thresholds
Apply pipeline will block an automatic apply if any threshold is violated and will create a `rollback` runbook entry with exact config diff
Canary rollout integration: first rollouts to 5% of traffic, automated reversion on regression within monitoring window
Operators can review a human-readable report (diff, sample outputs, metric deltas, flagged prompts) before approving manual apply
steps: Define reference corpus: 400 prompts across classification, summarization, API-style completions, and safety-sensitive queries
Implement micro-eval harness that computes BLEU/ROUGE/Embedding-sim similarity, log-likelihood delta, and API-specific heuristic checks
Create a staging runner that replays live-ish traffic samples with recommended batching/caching configs
Integrate with rollout service to perform 5%-25%-50% staged applies with automatic rollback hooks
Add telemetry hooks to Console: per-prompt deltas, token-cost impact, latency p95 changes
Produce a printable rollback playbook with exact config snapshot, affected pools, and PR/Change ID
test_plan: Unit tests for metric aggregators and threshold evaluation logic (CI pass required)
Synthetic regression injection: intentionally degrade model outputs to ensure detection rules trigger
End-to-end test in staging: run sample recommended configs from Cost Advisor and validate no false positives on stable baseline
Canary failure simulation: cause latency spike and validate automatic rollback triggers and alert routing
User acceptance: Solutions eng reviews human-readable reports for 3 different customer workloads
